title: Librarian of Congress Succession Modernization Act of 2015
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The expanded summary of the Senate passed version is repeated here.)

Librarian of Congress Succession Modernization Act of 2015

(Sec. 2) This bill limits the term of the Librarian of Congress to 10 years.

The individual appointed to the position may be reappointed in accordance with this requirement.

summary.headline: A 2015 law sets a 10-year limit on each Librarian of Congress's term, though a person may be reappointed.
summary.what_it_does: The law caps the Librarian of Congress's term at 10 years. The person appointed to the job may be reappointed after that term. The summary does not describe other changes.

who_it_affects.how: The Librarian's term of service is limited to 10 years, and the Librarian may be reappointed under the same limit.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 5, 2015. The summary does not give a separate effective date.
